welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.heading: Let's get you set up in ~5 minutes
welcome.sub: Realtime Translate translates your Google Meet calls in real time. Here's how it works:
welcome.diagramDirA: You speak in Portuguese, your contact hears English
welcome.diagramDirB: Your contact speaks English, you hear Portuguese

key.label: OpenAI Key
key.heading: Your OpenAI key
key.sub: Each user brings their own key. Cost: ~$0.30 per 5 minutes of conversation.
key.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace the current one
key.replaceHint: Leave blank to keep using the saved key.
key.signupLink: I don't have a key — take me to OpenAI signup
key.howToToggle: How do I get a key?
key.howToStep3: Create an API key (API Keys → Create new secret key)

cables.label: Virtual cables
cables.detectedSub: Ready to route audio between you and Meet.
cables.macDetectedSub: Ready to configure routes between the app and Meet on macOS.
cables.missingHeading: You need to install VB-CABLE A+B
cables.missingSub: It's a pair of virtual audio cables. Third-party software (donationware), safe and widely used.
cables.macMissingHeading: You need to configure virtual audio on macOS
cables.macMissingSub: VB-CABLE A+B is Windows-specific. On macOS, configure two virtual routes with BlackHole or Loopback to separate both call directions.
cables.rescanFailToast: Didn't detect it. Did you reboot after installing?
cables.macRescanFailToast: Didn't detect enough virtual routes. Check that macOS shows BlackHole/Loopback devices under Sound Input and Output.
cables.installStep1: Download the ZIP from the VB-Audio site
cables.installStep2: Extract the contents to a folder
cables.macInstallStep1: Install BlackHole or Loopback on macOS
cables.macInstallStep2: Create two independent virtual routes for the two call directions
cables.macInstallStep3: Confirm in System Settings → Sound that they appear as input and output devices

devices.label: Devices
devices.heading: Your audio devices
devices.sub: Select which mic and headset you use.
devices.micHint: Your physical microphone — where your voice is captured before translating.
devices.toMeetHint: Where the app sends translated audio. Should be CABLE-A (recommended below).
devices.toMeetHintMac: Where the app sends translated audio. Use a dedicated macOS virtual route for Meet's microphone.
devices.fromMeetHint: Where the app captures the contact's voice (coming from Meet). Should be CABLE-B (recommended below).
devices.fromMeetHintMac: Where the app captures the contact's voice. Use another macOS virtual route dedicated to Meet's speaker output.
devices.headsetHint: Where you hear the contact's translation. Use a separate headset if possible — avoids feedback with the microphone.
devices.staleCableWarning: Your Output/Capture selections aren't using the recommended VB-CABLE devices. Translation test may fail.

meet.label: Configure Meet
meet.heading: Configure Google Meet
meet.sub: This step is manual — we can't verify it automatically, but it's quick.
meet.step2: Click the 3 dots in the bottom-right corner → Settings
meet.step5: Speakers: select 'CABLE-B Input (VB-Audio Cable B)' (NOT the '16ch' one)
meet.step4Mac: Microphone: select the virtual route that receives translated app output
meet.step5Mac: Speakers: select the other virtual route that the app captures for translation

test.label: Test translation
test.heading: Test translation
test.sub: Let's validate everything works with 2 short calls to OpenAI (~$0.10 total). You can skip if you prefer.
test.directionAExplain: App will speak a Portuguese phrase, translate to English, and validate that the cable receives it.
test.directionBExplain: App will speak an English phrase, translate to Portuguese, and play it on your headset.
test.skipWarning: Translation may fail on the first call if something is misconfigured.
test.liveMicHint: Speak into the selected microphone. Translation plays on your headset and files are finalized when you stop.
test.liveMissingDevices: Select microphone and headset before live recording.
test.waveformLabel: Live waveform for input and translated output
test.noAudioOnCableA: No audio detected on CABLE-A Output
test.openaiNoAudio: OpenAI didn't return translated audio. Check your key/quota and the source language.
test.noLoopbackDespiteAudio: Audio was routed but didn't loop back through CABLE-A. Confirm 'Output to Meet' is set to CABLE-A Input.
test.confirmHeardPt: Did you hear a phrase in Portuguese in your headphones?

recording.title: Local recording
recording.sub: Record input, translated output, and an optional mix per session. Off by default.
recording.invalid: Select input, output, or mixed audio before enabling recording.

silenceGate.title: Silence gate
silenceGate.sub: Conservatively stops sending audio only after both directions are silent for about 3 seconds. Off by default.

review.heading: Settings
review.sub: Everything's configured. Edit anything that needs adjusting — clicking 'Edit' opens the corresponding wizard step.
